title: Validation rules
description: Conditions that prevent saving a record with inconsistent data. They apply to forms, inline editing, API, imports, automations and bulk actions.
help: The formula describes the error condition: when it results in true, the write is blocked and the message is shown to the user.

empty.title: No rules for this record type
empty.description: Create a rule to block writes that do not follow your process.

dialog.description: Write the condition that makes the record invalid and the message the user will see.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.keyHint: Stable identifier used by configuration packages. Leave blank to generate it from the name.
dialog.messageHint: Text shown to the user when the rule blocks the write.
dialog.fieldHint: The error is shown next to this field in the form.
dialog.expressionHint: Boolean formula. Example: amount > 10000 and is_blank(source)

test.title: Test against a record
test.recordHint: Evaluates the condition over the saved data of the chosen record.
test.fails: The rule would block this record.
test.notEvaluated: Fix the condition to test it.

toasts.conflict: The rule was changed by someone else. Reload and try again.

removeDialog.title: Delete rule
removeDialog.description: The rule "{{name}}" will stop applying and will be deleted. To only suspend it, deactivate it.
